name: Ray-casting Curvilinear Volumes
definition: A method for direct volume rendering of data sampled on a curvilinear grid (six-sided cells with non-planar, non-orthogonal faces) by casting rays directly through the volume without interpolating to a rectilinear grid first.
summary: Ray-casting Curvilinear Volumes directly renders data on irregular grids without interpolation, avoiding accumulation errors but running slower than rectilinear methods.
